name: Pebble Beetle
script:
on tick every 8:
  if mem[0] > 0 then mem[0] -= 1; return end
  if rand(10) < 3 then walk to anywhere; frame 1 + rand(2) end
end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, food) then seek food; eat; say 1
  elif has(neartraits, shiny) then face; say 2; mem[1] += 1
  end
  if mem[1] > 4 then burst sparkle; mem[1] = 0 end
end
on poke: stop; say 3; mem[0] = 20; emit zzz; end
on bumped: hop 10; sound boing; flip; end
on time night: stop; mem[0] = 120; end

name: Clockwork Mouse
script:
on poke: mem[0] = 40; frame 2; sound clock; say 1; end
on tick every 4:
  if mem[0] <= 0 then frame 1; return end
  mem[0] -= 1
  if rand(4) == 0 then walk to anywhere end
  if mem[0] == 1 then stop; frame 3; say 2; emit puff end
end
on near:
  if mem[0] > 0 and has(neartraits, clockwork) then face; say 3; signal 7 end
  if near == snail and sulking then nudge end
end
on signal 7:
  if mem[0] <= 0 then mem[0] = 10; hop 4 end
end
on jam jammed: mem[0] = 30; seek clockwork; end
on bumped: flip; sound clock; end

name: Puddle Frog
script:
on weather rainy: mem[0] = 1; say 1; walk to water; end
on weather sunny: mem[0] = 0; end
on tick every 12:
  if mem[0] == 1 and rand(4) == 0 then hop 14; sound splash; frame 2
  elif rand(8) == 0 then hop; frame 1 end
end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, wet) then seek wet; say 2
  elif has(neartraits, food) then eat; mem[1] += 1 end
  if mem[1] >= 3 then sound chirp; emit heart; mem[1] = 0 end
end
on world leak: walk to water; burst heart; end
on poke: hop 20; say 3; sound plop; end
on time night: emit note; end

name: Moth Lantern
script:
on time dusk: glow on; frame 2; fly; end
on time dawn: glow off; frame 1; home; end
on tick every 20:
  if time == night and rand(5) == 0 then emit sparkle end
  mem[0] += 1
  if mem[0] > 30 then home; mem[0] = 0 end
end
on poke: glow toggle; say 1; fly; end
on world dark: glow on; fly; say 2; end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, light) then fly; mem[0] = 0 end
end
on weather stormy: home; glow on; end

name: Tin Wind Chime
script:
on world breeze: mem[0] = 12; say 1; end
on weather stormy: mem[0] = 20; end
on tick every 2:
  if mem[0] > 0 then
    mem[0] -= 1; frame 1 + mem[0] % 3
    if rand(3) == 0 then sound ding; emit note end
  end
end
on poke: mem[0] = 6; sound ding; end
on bumped: mem[0] = 10; say 2; end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, music) then mem[0] = 4 end
end
on hour 12: mem[0] = 8; sound tune; end

name: Teapot Planter
script:
on tick every 40:
  mem[0] += 1
  if mem[0] > 6 then emit puff; drop; frame 2; mem[0] = 0
  else frame 1 end
end
on weather rainy: say 1; drop; sound plop; end
on time dawn: emit puff; say 2; end
on poke: say 3; sound fizz; burst puff; end
on berry:
  if berries > 3 then emit heart end
end
on world bloom: burst heart; frame 2; end
on new:
  if has(newtraits, plant) then say 2; emit sparkle end
end

name: Dandelion Wisp
script:
on world breeze: float 20; burst puff; say 1; end
on tick every 16:
  mem[0] += 1
  if mem[0] % 6 == 0 then float rand(8); frame 1 + mem[0] / 6 % 2 end
end
on poke: float 24; emit puff; end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, wild) then float 12; say 2 end
end
on weather sunny: emit sparkle; end
on bumped: burst puff; float 18; end
on time night: emit zzz; end

name: Soap Bubble Jelly
script:
on tick every 6:
  if rand(12) == 0 then frame 1 + rand(3); emit sparkle end
end
on poke:
  mem[0] += 1; sound fizz
  if mem[0] >= 3 then burst sparkle; sound pop; say 3; mem[0] = 0; float 0
  else say mem[0]; float 10 end
end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, fragile) then say 2; flip end
end
on weather rainy: glow on; float 16; end
on weather sunny: glow off; end
on signal 9: float 8; emit note; end
on bumped: sound pop; burst sparkle; float 0; end

name: Paper Cloud
script:
on weather rainy: frame 2; mem[0] = 1; say 1; end
on weather snowy: frame 3; mem[0] = 2; say 2; end
on weather sunny: frame 1; mem[0] = 0; end
on tick every 10:
  if mem[0] == 1 and rand(3) == 0 then emit puff; drop end
  if mem[0] == 2 and rand(3) == 0 then emit sparkle end
end
on poke:
  float 12; say 3
  mem[0] = (mem[0] + 1) % 3; frame mem[0] + 1
end
on world dark: frame 2; sound bang; end
on time night: emit zzz; end

name: Mushroom Stool
script:
on bumped:
  hop 6; sound boing; frame 2; mem[0] += 1
  if mem[0] >= 5 then burst puff; say 2; mem[0] = 0 end
end
on poke: frame 2; hop 4; say 1; sound boing; end
on tick every 24: frame 1; end
on weather rainy: emit puff; drop; end
on world bloom: burst puff; glow on; end
on time dawn: glow off; end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, sleepy) then emit zzz end
end

name: Knitted Armchair
script:
on near:
  if has(neartraits, sleepy) or has(neartraits, cosy) then mem[0] += 1; emit zzz end
  if mem[0] > 6 then say 1; emit heart; mem[0] = 0 end
end
on time night: frame 2; say 2; glow on; end
on time dawn: frame 1; glow off; end
on poke: say 3; sound plop; emit heart; end
on weather snowy: glow on; emit heart; end
on world visitor: say 1; burst heart; end
on tick every 60:
  if time == night and rand(3) == 0 then emit zzz end
end

name: Music Box Dresser
script:
on poke:
  if mem[0] == 0 then mem[0] = 24; sound tune; say 1; signal 9
  else mem[0] = 0; frame 1; say 2 end
end
on tick every 4:
  if mem[0] > 0 then
    mem[0] -= 1; frame 2 + mem[0] % 2
    if rand(3) == 0 then emit note end
    if mem[0] == 0 then frame 1 end
  end
end
on hour 20: mem[0] = 16; sound tune; end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, music) then mem[1] += 1 end
  if mem[1] > 3 then say 3; mem[1] = 0; mem[0] = 8 end
end
on jam fixed: sound tune; burst note; end

name: Marble Cairn
script:
on bumped: mem[0] += 1; frame 1 + mem[0] % 3; sound crunch; say 1; end
on tick every 30:
  if time == day and rand(4) == 0 then emit sparkle end
end
on weather sunny: burst sparkle; glow on; end
on weather cloudy: glow off; end
on poke: frame 1 + rand(3); sound coin; emit sparkle; end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, wild) then say 2; mem[1] += 1 end
  if mem[1] > 2 then throw; mem[1] = 0 end
end
on world ants: say 2; hop 3; end

name: Little Snow Globe
script:
on poke: mem[0] = 16; frame 2; sound fizz; say 1; end
on bumped: mem[0] = 24; frame 3; say 2; end
on tick every 3:
  if mem[0] > 0 then
    mem[0] -= 1
    if rand(2) == 0 then emit sparkle end
    if mem[0] == 0 then frame 1 end
  end
end
on weather snowy: mem[0] = 40; glow on; say 3; end
on weather sunny: glow off; end
on time night: glow on; end
on time dawn: glow off; end

name: Whispering Fossil
script:
on poke:
  if days > 3 then say 3 elif rand(2) == 0 then say 1 else say 2 end
  sound whoosh
end
on time night: frame 2; glow on; emit zzz; end
on time dawn: frame 1; glow off; end
on world leak: burst puff; sound splash; say 2; end
on hour 3:
  if rand(2) == 0 then sound whoosh; emit puff; frame 2 end
end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, spooky) then glow toggle; mem[0] += 1 end
  if mem[0] > 5 then burst zzz; mem[0] = 0 end
end

name: Copper Rain Gauge
script:
on weather rainy: mem[0] += 1; say 1; end
on weather stormy: mem[0] += 2; sound bang; end
on tick every 80:
  if mem[0] > 0 and weather != rainy and rand(4) == 0 then mem[0] -= 1; emit puff end
  if mem[0] >= 4 then frame 3 elif mem[0] >= 1 then frame 2 else frame 1 end
end
on poke:
  if mem[0] >= 4 then say 3; drop; mem[0] = 2; sound splash
  else say 2 end
end
on world leak: mem[0] = 5; sound plop; end

name: Sleepy Sunflower
script:
on time dawn: frame 2; say 1; emit sparkle; end
on time day: frame 3; end
on time dusk: frame 2; end
on time night: frame 1; emit zzz; end
on weather sunny: burst heart; end
on weather cloudy: say 2; end
on berry:
  mem[0] += 1
  if mem[0] >= 3 then burst sparkle; drop; mem[0] = 0 end
end
on poke:
  if time == night then say 3; emit zzz
  else hop 3; sound chirp; say 1 end
end
on world bloom: frame 3; burst heart; end

name: Bell Moss
script:
on poke:
  mem[0] += 1; sound ding; frame 2; signal 4
  if mem[0] >= 4 then say 2; burst note; mem[0] = 0 else say 1 end
end
on signal 4: emit note; end
on tick every 20:
  frame 1
  if playing and rand(3) == 0 then frame 2; emit note end
end
on world breeze: sound ding; emit note; frame 2; end
on hour 7: sound ding; say 1; end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, music) then sound ding end
end

name: Ghost Orchid
script:
on time night: glow on; frame 3; say 1; end
on time dawn: glow off; frame 1; end
on tick every 24:
  if time == night and rand(6) == 0 then emit sparkle; mem[0] += 1 end
  if mem[0] >= 5 then frame 2; say 2; mem[0] = 0 end
end
on weather foggy: glow on; burst puff; say 3; end
on world dark: glow on; burst sparkle; end
on poke: glow toggle; sound whoosh; end
on new:
  if has(newtraits, spooky) then burst heart; say 2 end
end

name: Straw Bee Skep
script:
on time day: fly; frame 2; end
on time dusk: home; frame 1; end
on tick every 40:
  mem[0] += 1
  if mem[0] > 8 then home; drop; emit heart; mem[0] = 0
  elif mem[0] == 4 and time == day then fly end
end
on world bloom: fly; burst heart; say 1; end
on weather rainy: home; say 2; end
on bumped: fly; sound fizz; say 3; burst puff; end
on poke: sound fizz; emit note; say 1; end
